articles.title: Inditex, Mango trade body calls for measures to prevent Barcelona unrest
articles.description: The Asociación Retail Textil España (Arte), the trade association for major fashion chains such as Inditex, Mango, Tendam and H&M, is calling on public administrations to take measures to prevent new episodes of violence like the one experienced in Barcelona …
